heading: INT. GRAND PLAZA HOTEL, BALLROOM B - ARBITRATION HEARING - DAY

units.text: INT. GRAND PLAZA HOTEL, BALLROOM B - ARBITRATION HEARING - DAY
A long table with water pitchers and legal pads.
A banner for a dental convention is still hanging on the wall.
Five people sit with their binders open.
Ms. Ottoline, for the record, your client signed the second addendum on the fourteenth.
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: My client signed a draft on the fourteenth. A draft is not an addendum.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: It had a signature page.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: It had a signature line, Mr. Rafferty. There's a distinction.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Arbitrator, may I interject?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: You may, Ms. Desai.
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: The addendum was circulated by email, acknowledged by email, and acted on within forty-eight hours. Whatever Ms. Ottoline calls it, her client behaved as if it were binding.
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Behaved. Not agreed.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: If I may, Arbitrator. The payments began on the sixteenth.
units.name: LORCAN

units.text: Mr. Lorcan, with respect, you are a witness, not counsel.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: I'm both. It's a small firm.
units.name: LORCAN

units.text: Order, please.
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: Arbitrator, the payments are the point. Our client sent fifteen thousand dollars each month for six months.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Under protest.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Under what protest? There's no letter.
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: There's a voicemail.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: A voicemail.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Time-stamped and transcribed.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Is the transcript in evidence?
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: Exhibit nine.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Exhibit nine is blank.
units.name: LORCAN

units.text: It is not blank, it is redacted.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Redacted by whom?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: By the court reporter.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Ms. Ottoline, the court reporter works for me.
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: Then I suspect she followed instructions.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Mine?
units.name: HARGREAVE

units.text: I didn't say yours.
units.name: OTTOLINE

units.text: Nobody speaks.
The banner behind them sags a little on its tape.
A dental hygienist pokes her head through the door, takes one look at the room, and withdraws.
